test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ________ of the movie was unexpected.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ending**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**ending**" is the correct noun form to describe the conclusion of a movie.
 
• The sentence refers to the finale of the movie, and "**ending**" is the most suitable term in this context.
 
• **Options 1, 3, and 4** are grammatically incorrect or do not fit logically in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The **ending**__ of the movie was unexpected."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "ends"** is incorrect because "ends" refers to multiple conclusions or the verb form, which does not fit here.
 
• **Option 3: "ended"** is incorrect because it is a past tense verb, not a noun.
 
• **Option 4: "end"** is incorrect because while "end" is a noun, "ending" is more appropriate for describing the conclusion of a story or movie.
